descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S09 「自定义模板没有类型就存不了（两个模式）」 Custom template cannot be saved without a type (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Creating a custom template requires a note-type selection (one of the 8 pilot templates or 'Procedure / other'); the template cannot be saved without one (step 3).（UAT TC-18；TFA-92599 AC 8；TFA-92599 How it works 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Settings -> Note Templates -> New, in Hospital and in Nursing Home

When Fill name and instructions, leave the type empty, press Save Template; then close the form and look at the template list

Then Save is refused and the form stays open with a required-field message; no 'QA ... no-type' template appears in the list

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: after Save the form is still open (mustContain 'Template Name', known gap until AC 8) and shows no save error (mustNotContain 'Could not save template', which the form shows when the server rejects a save); after closing it the Settings template list mustNotContain the template's name. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
